description:
Introducing the 2000 Chrysler Town and Country Limited, a luxurious and versatile minivan that combines comfort, space, and performance with a powerful 3.8L V6 engine.

This impressive engine delivers an exhilarating **180 horsepower** and a robust **240 ft. lbs. of torque**, ensuring a smooth and responsive driving experience.

With its **4-speed automatic transmission**, you'll enjoy seamless shifts and the ability to tackle any road with confidence, whether you're navigating city streets or cruising on the highway.

Step inside this family-friendly vehicle, and you'll find a spacious, well-appointed interior featuring premium materials and an array of thoughtful amenities designed for ultimate convenience.

Perfect for long trips or daily errands, the Town and Country Limited offers **generous seating** for up to seven passengers, along with ample cargo space to accommodate all your needs.

Safety is paramount, and this minivan comes equipped with features designed to keep you and your loved ones protected on every journey.

Whether you're running errands, going on road trips, or simply enjoying a night out, the 2000 Chrysler Town and Country Limited delivers an exceptional experience that blends practicality with luxury.

Don't miss out on the opportunity to own this well-maintained minivan that is ready for your next adventure. Experience the perfect blend of style, comfort, and performance today!
